title: CliPayload
description: CLI commands and their explicit outputs. Domain definitions, shared configurations, and side-effect publications are defined in sibling schema files.

CliCommand.description: A single JSON command supplied to python -m zygo.cli.v0 --args JSON. The command field selects the request variant.

CliOutput.description: Explicit command results, distinct from side-effect publications. Workflow execution and model training have no separate result payload. Their completion is reported by process exit status.
